description.en: On desktop 1.3, each Esc press cancels building placement, dismantling, relocation or native cloning first, then collapses expanded native/capsule/classic categories, then opens the menu. Holding Esc does not skip layers. Hot changes affect subsequent keys only; turn off to use native behavior.
description.sch: 桌面1.3按Esc先取消建筑放置、拆除、搬迁或原生克隆，再收起已展开的原版/胶囊/经典分类卡片，最后打开菜单；每次按下只处理一层，长按不连续穿层。开关即时影响后续按键，关闭恢复原版行为。
description.modsch: 桌面1.3按Esc先取消建筑放置、拆除、搬迁或原生克隆，再收起已展开的原版/胶囊/经典分类卡片，最后打开菜单；每次按下只处理一层，长按不连续穿层。开关即时影响后续按键，关闭恢复原版行为。
description.tch: 桌面1.3按Esc先取消建築放置、拆除、搬遷或原生複製，再收起已展開的原版/膠囊/經典分類卡片，最後開啟選單；每次按下只處理一層，長按不連續穿層。開關即時影響後續按鍵，關閉恢復原版行為。

label.sch: 自动保存卡顿修复
label.modsch: 自动保存卡顿修复
label.tch: 自動儲存卡頓修復

description.en: Every 10 seconds, update one global autosave. About every 4 minutes, add history to the played manual slot without overwriting its manual save point. Transfer only changed records, including Steam Cloud. New cloud records need this Loader to read. Save and reload to switch; restart after installing.
description.sch: 每10秒只更新一个全局自动存档，约每4分钟向正在游玩的普通槽追加历史，不覆盖其手动保存点。进程间及Steam云端只传变化记录。新增云记录需本Loader读取。保存并重新加载后切换；安装后完整重启。
description.modsch: 每10秒只更新一个全局自动存档，约每4分钟向正在游玩的普通槽追加历史，不覆盖其手动保存点。进程间及Steam云端只传变化记录。新增云记录需本Loader读取。保存并重新加载后切换；安装后完整重启。
description.tch: 每10秒只更新一個全域自動存檔，約每4分鐘向正在遊玩的普通槽追加歷史，不覆蓋其手動儲存點。處理程序間及Steam雲端只傳變更記錄。新增雲端記錄需本Loader讀取。儲存並重新載入後切換；安裝後完整重啟。

description.tch: 切換語言或重建原版/經典商店後，讓桌面1.3拆解按鈕圖案符合目前等級。僅修正顯示，不改等級、資源和退款。開啟時也補正目前圖案，關閉停止後續補正，支援即時預覽。

description.ru: Выберите полноэкранный, безрамочный или обычный оконный режим. Безрамочный режим убирает системный заголовок после следующего запуска игры.

description.pl: Wybierz pełny ekran, bez ramki albo zwykłe okno. Tryb bez ramki usuwa systemowy pasek tytułu po następnym uruchomieniu gry.

description.ro: Alege ecran complet, fără bordură sau fereastră normală. Fără bordură elimină bara de titlu a sistemului după următoarea pornire a jocului.
description.no: Velg fullskjerm, kantløs eller vanlig vindu. Kantløs fjerner systemtittellinjen etter neste spillstart.

enableEndingSkip.label: Ending skip
enableEndingSkip.description: Show a skip button during the pinhole ending and credits sequence.

enableAccessibilityButtons.label: Accessibility buttons
enableAccessibilityButtons.description: Show the bottom accessibility control bar.

enableStabilizerSurgeFlashReduction.label: Stabilizer surge flash reduction
enableStabilizerSurgeFlashReduction.description: After the void altar exists, hide full-screen flashes caused by stabilizer-triggered surge effects.

enableResourceGlowColors.label: Resource glow colors
enableResourceGlowColors.description: Color resource icon glows by resource, with optional per-resource overrides.

enablePlayTimeCounter.label: Play time counter
enablePlayTimeCounter.description: Show the active run play-time counter on the game canvas.

playTimeCounterPosition.label: Play time counter position
playTimeCounterPosition.description: Slide between bottom-left, top-center, and bottom-right.

resourceGlowColors.label: Resource glow palette
resourceGlowColors.description: Per-resource glow color overrides. Empty rows use each resource's native color.

farthestZoom.label: Farthest zoom
farthestZoom.description: Lower values show more of the world. Vanilla far limit is 0.3.

closestZoom.label: Closest zoom
closestZoom.description: Higher values zoom closer to the world. Vanilla near limit is 2.

fallbackZoom.label: Fallback zoom
fallbackZoom.description: Used when the saved zoom value is missing or invalid.

enableMouseAnchoredZoom.label: Mouse-position zoom
enableMouseAnchoredZoom.description: When using Shift/Ctrl + mouse wheel to zoom, keep the world point under the mouse instead of zooming around the screen center.

enableMouseAnchoredWaypointTeleport.label: Mouse-position waypoint teleport
enableMouseAnchoredWaypointTeleport.description: After using Waypoint LV1 or LV2, place the destination waypoint under the mouse instead of the screen center.

enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.label: Origin arrow tip anchor
enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.description: Anchor the distant-origin cursor arrow tip at the mouse position instead of centering the arrow over the mouse.

enableChasmLineRenderer.label: Chasm line renderer
enableChasmLineRenderer.description: Allow this mod to replace the chasm-to-resource lines with the selected renderer.

chasmLineRendererMode.label: Chasm line rendering mode
chasmLineRendererMode.description: Canvas 2D uses the original game drawing. WebGL renders the same chasm-to-resource curves through a GPU-backed canvas.

enableChasmLineDistanceOverride.label: Chasm lines ignore distance
enableChasmLineDistanceOverride.description: Keep rendering chasm-to-resource lines even when the chasm is outside the normal visible range.

enableFloorGridLines.label: Floor grid outlines
enableFloorGridLines.description: Draw thin outlines around the in-game floor cells.

floorGridLineRealityColor.label: Reality floor grid outline color
floorGridLineRealityColor.description: Leave empty to use the default dark gray outline in reality.

floorGridLineVoidColor.label: Void floor grid outline color
floorGridLineVoidColor.description: Leave empty to use the default white outline in the void.

enableVoidReturnFadeSkip.label: Skip void return fade
enableVoidReturnFadeSkip.description: When returning from the void to reality, remove the long white recovery fade and show the clear view immediately.

enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.label: Skip waypoint teleport fade
enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.description: When using Waypoint LV1 or LV2, remove the black recovery fade after teleporting.

enableExplainerFix.label: Explainer fix
enableExplainerFix.description: Refresh pulsing explainer hints after language changes and use readable light text in the void.

disableShiftCtrlZoomShortcut.label: Disable Shift/Ctrl zoom shortcut
disableShiftCtrlZoomShortcut.description: Prevent pressing Shift or Ctrl alone from resetting the camera zoom, while keeping Shift/Ctrl + wheel zooming available.

enableDynamicCamera.label: Dynamic camera
enableDynamicCamera.description: Enable keyboard-controlled camera pitch and rotation.

cameraPitch.label: Camera pitch
cameraPitch.description: Live pitch control. 0.50 matches vanilla; larger values look more top-down.

disableGradientLightningFlash.label: Disable gradient mine flash
disableGradientLightningFlash.description: Prevent Gradient mine Reality conversion lightning from filling the screen, while keeping the lightning path, sound, and resource production.

disableIdleSplash.label: Disable offline earnings simulation
disableIdleSplash.description: Skip the offline earnings simulation when loading a save. Time spent away will grant no offline resources or other simulated progress.

enableFloorColorOverride.label: Reality floor color override
enableFloorColorOverride.description: Replace the reality floor background color with a configurable color.

floorColorOverrideRealityColor.label: Reality floor color
floorColorOverrideRealityColor.description: Color used for the reality floor background while the override is enabled.

enableAccessibilityButtons.description: Pokazyvaet nizhnyuyu panel knopok dostupnosti.

enableMouseAnchoredZoom.description: Pri Shift/Ctrl + koleso myshi uderzhivaet tochku mira pod myshyu vmesto masshtaba ot tsentra ekrana.

enableMouseAnchoredWaypointTeleport.label: Teleport-tochka pod myshyu
enableMouseAnchoredWaypointTeleport.description: Posle Waypoint LV1 ili LV2 stavit punkt naznacheniya pod mysh, a ne v tsentr ekrana.

enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.label: Privyazka konchika strelki k nachalu
enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.description: Zakreplyaet konchik kursornoi strelki daleko ot nachala v pozitsii myshi vmesto tsentrirovaniya strelki poverh myshi.

enableChasmLineRenderer.label: Render lines chasm
enableChasmLineRenderer.description: Allow the mod to replace chasm-to-resource lines with the selected renderer.

chasmLineRendererMode.label: Chasm line render mode
chasmLineRendererMode.description: Canvas 2D uses original drawing. WebGL uses a GPU-backed canvas.

enableChasmLineDistanceOverride.label: Linii razloma bez distantsii
enableChasmLineDistanceOverride.description: Linii ot razloma k resursam risuyutsya, dazhe kogda razlom vne obychnoy vidimoy zony.

enableFloorGridLines.label: Kontury kletok pola
enableFloorGridLines.description: Risuet tonkie kontury vokrug kletok pola v igre.

floorGridLineRealityColor.label: Tsvet setki pola realnosti
floorGridLineRealityColor.description: Pustoe znachenie ispolzuet temno-seryy kontur v realnosti.

floorGridLineVoidColor.label: Tsvet setki pola pustoty
floorGridLineVoidColor.description: Pustoe znachenie ispolzuet belyy kontur v pustote.

enableVoidReturnFadeSkip.label: Propusk belogo zatuhaniya iz pustoty
enableVoidReturnFadeSkip.description: Pri vozvrate iz pustoty v realnost ubiraet dolgoe beloe vosstanovlenie i srazu pokazyvaet chetkiy vid.

enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.label: Propusk zatmeneni teleport-tochki
enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.description: Pri ispolzovanii Waypoint LV1 ili LV2 ubiraet chernoe vosstanovlenie ekrana posle teleportatsii.

enableExplainerFix.label: Ispravlenie podskazok
enableExplainerFix.description: Obnovlyaet pulsiruyushchie podskazki posle smeny yazyka i delaet tekst svetlym v pustote.

disableShiftCtrlZoomShortcut.label: Otklyuchit Shift/Ctrl zoom
disableShiftCtrlZoomShortcut.description: Ne pozvolyaet odinochnomu Shift ili Ctrl sbrosit masshtab kamery, no ostavlyaet Shift/Ctrl + koleso.

enableDynamicCamera.label: Dinamicheskaya kamera
enableDynamicCamera.description: Vklyuchaet naklon i povorot kamery s upravleniem klavishami.

cameraPitch.label: Naklon kamery
cameraPitch.description: Zhivaya nastroika naklona. 0.50 kak v originale; bolshe znachit vid sverkhu.

disableGradientLightningFlash.label: Otklyuchit mertsanie gradientnoy shakhty
disableGradientLightningFlash.description: Ubiraet polnoekrannuyu vspyshku molnii pri preobrazovanii Reality gradientnoy shakhtoy, sohranyaya liniyu molnii, zvuk i proizvodstvo resursov.

disableIdleSplash.label: Otklyuchit simulyatsiyu oflayn-dokhoda
disableIdleSplash.description: Pri zagruzke sokhraneniya propuskaet simulyatsiyu oflayn-dokhoda. Za vremya vne igry ne budut nachisleny resursy ili drugoy smodelirovannyy progress.

enableFloorColorOverride.label: Podmena tsveta pola realnosti
enableFloorColorOverride.description: Zamenyaet fon pola v realnosti nastroyennym tsvetom.

floorColorOverrideRealityColor.label: Tsvet pola realnosti
floorColorOverrideRealityColor.description: Tsvet fona pola realnosti, kogda podmena vklyuchena.

enableAccessibilityButtons.label: Bedienhilfen-Schaltflächen
enableAccessibilityButtons.description: Zeigt die untere Leiste mit Bedienhilfen-Schaltflaechen.

playTimeCounterPosition.label: Position des Spielzeitzählers
playTimeCounterPosition.description: Slide between bottom-left, top-center, and bottom-right.

enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.label: Spitze des Ursprungspfeils verankern

enableChasmLineRenderer.label: Risslinien-Renderer

floorGridLineRealityColor.label: Bodenrasterfarbe Realitaet

enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.label: Wegpunkt-Teleport-Fade ueberspringen

enableMouseAnchoredWaypointTeleport.label: Waypoint zem peles
enableMouseAnchoredWaypointTeleport.description: Pec Waypoint LV1 vai LV2 merkis nonak zem peles, nevis ekrana centra.

enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.label: Piesiet sakuma bultas galu
enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.description: Piestiprina kursora bultas galu talu no sakuma pie peles pozicijas, nevis centre bultu virs peles.

enableChasmLineRenderer.label: Plaisas liniju renderetajs
enableChasmLineRenderer.description: Mods var aizstat plaisas un resursu linijas ar izveleto renderetaju.

chasmLineRendererMode.label: Plaisas liniju renderesanas rezims
chasmLineRendererMode.description: Canvas 2D izmanto originalo zimesanu. WebGL izmanto GPU canvas.

enableChasmLineDistanceOverride.label: Plaisas linijas bez distances
enableChasmLineDistanceOverride.description: Plaisas un resursu linijas paliek redzamas ari arpus parasta redzama attaluma.

enableFloorGridLines.label: Gridas konturas
enableFloorGridLines.description: Zime smalkas konturas ap gridas lauciniem.

floorGridLineRealityColor.label: Realitates gridas konturu krasa
floorGridLineRealityColor.description: Tukss izmanto noklusejuma tumsi peleku konturu realitate.

floorGridLineVoidColor.label: Tuksuma gridas konturu krasa
floorGridLineVoidColor.description: Tukss izmanto noklusejuma baltu konturu tuksumaa.

enableVoidReturnFadeSkip.label: Izlaist balto atgriesanos no tuksuma
enableVoidReturnFadeSkip.description: Atgriezoties no tuksuma realitate, nonem ilgo balto parpludumu un uzreiz rada skaidru skatu.

enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.label: Izlaist Waypoint teleportesanas fade
enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.description: Lietojot Waypoint LV1 vai LV2, nonem melno atgriesanas fade pec teleportesanas.

enableExplainerFix.label: Padomu labojums
enableExplainerFix.description: Atsvaidzina pulsojosus padomus pec valodas mainas un tuksumaa izmanto gaisu, salasamu tekstu.

disableShiftCtrlZoomShortcut.label: Izslegt Shift/Ctrl talummainu
disableShiftCtrlZoomShortcut.description: Neatlauj Shift vai Ctrl vieniem pasiem atiestatit kameras talummainu, bet Shift/Ctrl + ritenis paliek.

enableDynamicCamera.label: Dinamiska kamera
enableDynamicCamera.description: Iesledz ar tastaturu vadamu kameras slipumu un rotaciju.

cameraPitch.label: Kameras slipums
cameraPitch.description: Tiesraides slipuma kontrole. 0.50 atbilst originalam; lielakas vertibas ir tuvak skatam no augsas.

disableGradientLightningFlash.label: Izslegt gradienta raktuves zibsnus
disableGradientLightningFlash.description: Neatlauj gradienta raktuves Reality parveides zibenim aizpildit ekranu, bet saglaba zibens liniju, skanu un razosanu.

disableIdleSplash.label: Atspējot bezsaistes ienākumu simulāciju
disableIdleSplash.description: Ielādējot saglabātu spēli, izlaiž bezsaistes ienākumu simulāciju. Par laiku ārpus spēles netiks piešķirti resursi vai cits simulēts progress.

enableFloorColorOverride.label: Realitates gridas krasas aizvietosana
enableFloorColorOverride.description: Aizvieto realitates gridas fona krasu ar iestatamu krasu.

floorColorOverrideRealityColor.label: Realitates gridas krasa
floorColorOverrideRealityColor.description: Krasa realitates gridas fonam, kad aizvietosana ir ieslegta.

enableAccessibilityButtons.label: Butoane accesibilitate
enableAccessibilityButtons.description: Afiseaza bara inferioara cu butoane de accesibilitate.

playTimeCounterPosition.label: Poziție contor timp
playTimeCounterPosition.description: Slide between bottom-left, top-center, and bottom-right.

enableMouseAnchoredZoom.label: Zoom la pozitia mouse-ului
enableMouseAnchoredZoom.description: Cu Shift/Ctrl + rotita mouse-ului, pastreaza punctul lumii de sub mouse in loc sa faca zoom din centrul ecranului.

enableMouseAnchoredWaypointTeleport.label: Waypoint sub mouse
enableMouseAnchoredWaypointTeleport.description: Dupa Waypoint LV1 sau LV2, pune waypoint-ul destinatie sub mouse in locul centrului ecranului.

enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.label: Ancoreaza varful sagetii originii
enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.description: Ancoreaza varful sagetii cursorului departe de origine la pozitia mouse-ului, in loc sa centreze sageata peste mouse.

enableChasmLineRenderer.label: Randare linii fisura
enableChasmLineRenderer.description: Permite modului sa inlocuiasca liniile dintre fisura si resurse cu randarea aleasa.

chasmLineRendererMode.label: Mod randare linii fisura
chasmLineRendererMode.description: Canvas 2D foloseste desenarea originala. WebGL foloseste un canvas GPU.

enableChasmLineDistanceOverride.label: Linii fisura fara distanta
enableChasmLineDistanceOverride.description: Pastreaza liniile dintre fisura si resurse chiar in afara razei vizibile normale.

enableFloorGridLines.label: Contururi grila podea
enableFloorGridLines.description: Deseneaza contururi subtiri in jurul celulelor podelei.

floorGridLineRealityColor.label: Culoare grila podea realitate
floorGridLineRealityColor.description: Gol foloseste conturul implicit gri inchis in realitate.

floorGridLineVoidColor.label: Culoare grila podea vid
floorGridLineVoidColor.description: Gol foloseste conturul implicit alb in vid.

enableVoidReturnFadeSkip.label: Sari peste fade-ul din vid
enableVoidReturnFadeSkip.description: La revenirea din vid in realitate, elimina estomparea alba lunga si arata imediat imaginea clara.

enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.label: Sari fade teleport Waypoint
enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.description: Cand folosesti Waypoint LV1 sau LV2, elimina fade-ul negru de revenire dupa teleportare.

enableExplainerFix.label: Corectie indicii
enableExplainerFix.description: Actualizeaza indiciile pulsante dupa schimbarea limbii si foloseste text luminos in vid.

disableShiftCtrlZoomShortcut.label: Dezactiveaza zoom Shift/Ctrl
disableShiftCtrlZoomShortcut.description: Impiedica Shift sau Ctrl singur sa reseteze zoomul camerei, dar pastreaza Shift/Ctrl + rotita.

enableDynamicCamera.label: Camera dinamica
enableDynamicCamera.description: Activeaza inclinarea si rotatia camerei controlate din tastatura.

cameraPitch.label: Inclinare camera
cameraPitch.description: Control live. 0.50 este ca in jocul original; valori mai mari arata mai de sus.

disableGradientLightningFlash.label: Dezactiveaza flash mina gradient
disableGradientLightningFlash.description: Impiedica fulgerul de conversie Reality al minei gradient sa umple ecranul, pastrand traseul, sunetul si productia.

disableIdleSplash.label: Dezactivează simularea câștigurilor offline
disableIdleSplash.description: Omite simularea câștigurilor offline la încărcarea unei salvări. Timpul petrecut în afara jocului nu va acorda resurse sau alt progres simulat.

enableFloorColorOverride.label: Inlocuire culoare podea realitate
enableFloorColorOverride.description: Inlocuieste culoarea de fundal a podelei din realitate cu o culoare configurabila.

floorColorOverrideRealityColor.label: Culoare podea realitate
floorColorOverrideRealityColor.description: Culoarea folosita pentru fundalul podelei din realitate cand inlocuirea este activa.

enableAccessibilityButtons.label: Tilgjengelighetsknapper
enableAccessibilityButtons.description: Viser den nedre linjen med tilgjengelighetsknapper.

playTimeCounterPosition.label: Plassering av spilletidteller
playTimeCounterPosition.description: Slide between bottom-left, top-center, and bottom-right.

enableMouseAnchoredZoom.label: Zoom ved museposisjon
enableMouseAnchoredZoom.description: Med Shift/Ctrl + musehjul beholdes verdenspunktet under musen i stedet for zoom rundt skjermsenteret.

enableMouseAnchoredWaypointTeleport.label: Waypoint under musen
enableMouseAnchoredWaypointTeleport.description: Etter Waypoint LV1 eller LV2 plasseres maal-waypoint under musen i stedet for skjermsenteret.

enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.label: Fest spissen pa opprinnelsespilen
enableOriginArrowTipAnchor.description: Fester spissen pa markorpilen langt fra opprinnelsen til museposisjonen, i stedet for a sentrere pilen over musen.

enableChasmLineRenderer.label: Kløftlinje-renderer
enableChasmLineRenderer.description: Lar modden erstatte linjene mellom kloften og ressursene med valgt renderer.

chasmLineRendererMode.label: Renderingsmodus for kloftlinjer
chasmLineRendererMode.description: Canvas 2D bruker original tegning. WebGL bruker et GPU-canvas.

enableChasmLineDistanceOverride.label: Kloftlinjer uten avstand
enableChasmLineDistanceOverride.description: Tegner linjer fra kloft til ressurser selv utenfor vanlig synlig rekkevidde.

enableFloorGridLines.label: Omriss for gulvrutenett
enableFloorGridLines.description: Tegner tynne omriss rundt gulvceller.

floorGridLineRealityColor.label: Gulvrutenettfarge i virkelighet
floorGridLineRealityColor.description: Tomt bruker standard morkegratt omriss i virkeligheten.

floorGridLineVoidColor.label: Gulvrutenettfarge i tomrom
floorGridLineVoidColor.description: Tomt bruker standard hvitt omriss i tomrommet.

enableVoidReturnFadeSkip.label: Hopp over hvit fade fra tomrom
enableVoidReturnFadeSkip.description: Nar du gar fra tomrommet tilbake til virkeligheten, fjernes den lange hvite faden.

enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.label: Hopp over waypoint-fade
enableWaypointTeleportFadeSkip.description: Nar du bruker Waypoint LV1 eller LV2, fjernes den svarte gjenopprettingsfaden etter teleportering.

enableExplainerFix.label: Hint-fiks
enableExplainerFix.description: Oppdaterer pulserende hint etter sprakbytte og bruker lys, lesbar tekst i tomrommet.

disableShiftCtrlZoomShortcut.label: Deaktiver Shift/Ctrl-zoom
disableShiftCtrlZoomShortcut.description: Hindrer Shift eller Ctrl alene i a nullstille kamerazoom, men beholder Shift/Ctrl + hjul.

enableDynamicCamera.label: Dynamisk kamera
enableDynamicCamera.description: Aktiver kameravinkel og rotasjon styrt med tastatur.

cameraPitch.label: Kameravinkel
cameraPitch.description: Direkte vinkelkontroll. 0.50 er som originalt; hoyere verdier ser mer ovenfra.

disableGradientLightningFlash.label: Deaktiver gradientgruveblink
disableGradientLightningFlash.description: Hindrer Reality-konverteringslyn fra gradientgruven i a fylle skjermen, men beholder lynbane, lyd og produksjon.

disableIdleSplash.label: Deaktiver simulering av offline-inntekter
disableIdleSplash.description: Hopper over simuleringen av offline-inntekter når et lagret spill lastes. Tid borte fra spillet gir ingen ressurser eller annen simulert fremgang.

enableFloorColorOverride.label: Overstyr gulvfarge i virkelighet
enableFloorColorOverride.description: Erstatter bakgrunnsfargen paa gulvet i virkelighet med en konfigurerbar farge.

floorColorOverrideRealityColor.label: Gulvfarge i virkelighet
floorColorOverrideRealityColor.description: Fargen brukt paa gulvbakgrunnen i virkelighet mens overstyring er aktiv.
